scope: Native resolution/window-mode trials; bounded advance of M3. Not an M1/M2 acceptance result.
owner: Existing local controller CoastalUISessionComponent owns one internal CoastalDisplaySettings UObject.
platform: Windows non-editor Game world, standalone single local player, standard UGameUserSettings; no XR system
confirmation: Matching observed FViewport on a later frame, new presentation opportunity after that match, current top ticket/epoch, foreground, before deadline.
rollback: One best-effort request for actual pretrial size/window mode; observe on later frame. Failure locks this owner. No window position/monitor/HDR/refresh restoration guarantee.
save: Only explicit Keep and request engine settings save. Calls ConfirmVideoMode/SaveSettings; void return does not verify disk persistence. Standard SaveSettings serializes other existing engine settings too.
session_only: Retire trial without editing UGameUserSettings values; next trial captures actual kept viewport.
